links.outcome: Between-session reproducibility of LLM classifications on repeated runs one week apart
links.effect: Between-session reproducibility was fair for GPT-5 (κ: 0.360) and moderate for Gemini 2.5 Pro (κ: 0.485); inter-model agreement slight (κ: 0.035 at S1, 0.086 at S2).
links.quote: Between-session reproducibility was fair for GPT-5 (κ: 0.360) and moderate for Gemini 2.5 Pro (κ: 0.485), and inter-model agreement was slight at both sessions (κ: 0.035 at S1 and κ: 0.086 at S2).

links.outcome: Multimodal LLM diagnostic accuracy versus radiologist on same HRCT images
links.effect: Radiologist accuracy 96.0% (κ 0.921); GPT-5 43.6%/46.5% and Gemini 2.5 Pro 49.5%/47.5% in S1/S2, with specificity 1.9%-13.2%.
links.quote: The radiologist achieved an accuracy of 96.0% (95% CI: 90.3-98.4) with almost perfect agreement with the reference standard (κ: 0.921).

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial multimodal foundation models (GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro) on temporal bone HRCT key images for diagnostic classification and reproducibility without testing specific deployment practices.
